body:
Items requiring a preview update originate from two sources:
1. File previews (`queue_resource_preview()`)
2. Resource instance previews (`queue_edited_resource_preview()`)

When the resource file is in use (i.e., no corresponding cached instance exists in the `ResourceCache`), file preview generation proceeds normally.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82f2dda6-dd2b-4ead-84bf-f711669363cb

The call to `queue_resource_preview()` is made directly or indirectly in `FileSystemDock` or `EditorFileSystem` (`EditorResourcePreview::check_for_invalidation()`).

However, file changes should be detected in `EditorFileSystem`, so reload should complete there before `queue_resource_preview()`.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1eb0374e5f3efa05d8a9914f482b894b5b1f6b9c/editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp#L1064

As of now, it occurs quite late. Simply calling `EditorFileSystem::update_file()` will not trigger a reload.
